name: questions.security_iam.baseline
description: Baseline questions for authentication, authorization, encryption, and compliance posture.

questions.text: What is the primary user-authentication mechanism?
questions.rationale: Authentication floor determines the ceiling for almost every other IAM control.

questions.text: Which authorization model is in use?
questions.rationale: Authorization maturity correlates directly with the blast-radius of a credential compromise.

questions.text: Is sensitive data encrypted at rest AND in transit?
questions.rationale: Table-stakes control — gaps here usually mean the engagement needs a remediation track, not an assessment track.

questions.text: Any security incidents or near-misses in the last 12 months?
questions.rationale: Recent incidents are the richest source of evidence for control weaknesses and cultural posture.

questions.text: Which compliance regimes apply (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI, SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.)?
questions.rationale: Compliance set prunes the option tree on cloud region, logging, data residency, and audit requirements.

questions.text: Is secret management centralised (vault / KMS / cloud native secrets)?
questions.rationale: Secret sprawl is a leading indicator of broader hygiene issues across the estate.
